vr.look: A bank is a place that keeps people's money safe. Money is something everyone agrees to take when they buy and sell. Good money lasts, is easy to carry, is easy to count and is trusted.

steps.title: Get ready
steps.html:
@PLACE@

In your video, you say these 2 sentences:

@SAY@

Practice now. Say both before the timer ends.

@TIMER@

In VR, this page is on the Canvas tab too.

steps.title: Go in
steps.html:
🔗 First time only: connect Canvas at xr.optimaed.com. See Having trouble in VR? below.

Open the On-Demand app. Click Explore. Type Bank in Filter environments. Click National Bank, then Begin Solo.

steps.title: Scout the bank
steps.html: Move with the thumbstick. Walk through the bank. Look at the counters, the doors and the walls. Look for places that keep money safe.

steps.title: Record your video and send it
steps.html:
Open your menu, click Library, then Camera. Move the tablet until the bank fits.

Click Record video. Say your 2 sentences. Click it again to stop.

Click the Canvas tab and pick @CANVAS@. Click Choose from My Files, pick your video, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag.

🔁 Want to fix it? Record a new video and send it again.

steps.title: Check and leave
steps.html: Press the Meta button, then click Quit. Check that your video is in the Canvas assignment. Not there? Open Having trouble in VR?

extra.html: Slowly show the room while you record, so Opti sees how the bank keeps money safe.

vr.full: One video, 30 seconds or less, that shows the bank while you say both sentences.

studio.title: The Money Test
studio.look: Good money passes four tests: it lasts, it is easy to carry, it is easy to count, and it is trusted (everyone agrees it is worth something). Four objects are waiting to be tested.
studio.do: Read about the object. Tap every test it passes. Then press Check.

game.done: All four tested! Only the silver dollar passed every test. That is why it worked as money.

things.name: A silver dollar
things.what: A coin made of silver in 1795.
things.ok: It passed all four tests! Silver coins lasted hundreds of years.

why.lasts: Does silver fall apart? It lasts a long time.
why.carry: A coin fits in your pocket.
why.count: You can count coins one by one.

things.name: Money cowrie shells
things.what: Small shells used as money in parts of Africa and Asia. You need a heavy bag of them to buy something big.
things.ok: Right! Shells last and are easy to count, but a big buy needs a heavy bag, and not everyone trusted them.

why.carry: Read again: a big buy needs a heavy bag of shells.
why.count: You can count shells one by one.
why.trust: Read again: shells were not trusted everywhere.

things.name: A rock from the yard
things.what: A small rock. Anyone can pick one up for free.
things.ok: Right! A rock lasts and is easy to carry and count, but no one agrees it is worth something.

why.lasts: Does a rock fall apart? It lasts.
why.carry: A small rock fits in your pocket.
why.trust: Would a store take a rock anyone can pick up? Not trusted.

things.name: An ice cube
things.ok: Right! You can carry and count ice cubes, but they melt, and no one agrees they are worth something.

why.lasts: What happens to ice on a warm day? It melts.
why.carry: An ice cube is easy to carry.
why.trust: Would a store take an ice cube? Not trusted.
